description: This file is a CMake script used to locate and set up dependencies for the TTS (Text-to-Speech) library within a build system. It searches for necessary libraries and header files, sets relevant variables, and marks important variables as advanced options.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Searches for a package, here used for PkgConfig

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds the path to headers or files by name

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets CMake variables, with optional cache

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes and executes another CMake script

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced, hiding them from normal user interfaces

calls: set(TTS_INCLUDE_DIRS ... CACHE PATH "Path to TTS include")
set(TTSC_INCLUDE_DIRS ... CACHE PATH "Path to TTSClient include")
